notice.message: Local lexical vectors for mechanism demonstration only; not real semantics
notice.description: Similarity is computed by the built-in deterministic lexical vectors (offline and reproducible) and does not represent the quality of a commercial semantic model. Running flows write automatically through the memory tool; operators (operate permission) can manually create/edit memories here (marked as manual), and deletion requires an admin.
